With three wishes at his fingertips, Aladdin sets out to win the heart of Princess Jasmine and prove he is worthy of a whole new world. But the evil Jafar has plans of his own, and Aladdin soon learns that true magic comes not from wishes, but from being honest, courageous, and true to yourself.
